title: A gate that names money, an operator-only act, a scope change or running a program is blocking whatever its class
goal: gate add makes a gate blocking whatever its class and prints strict <kind> '<word>' when its question, options, do or host_check words name money, an act only the operator can do, a scope change or running a program on input; answer refuses a provisional answer to such a gate; a design question with none of those words stays provisional; test_authority's derivation test gains a planted case per kind for gate add, answer, set --touch and check, within the test ceiling and with no new test id

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t; d=t.mkdtemp(); r=lambda *a: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); i=r("new","story","--title","S","--goal","g","--touch","src/a.py").stdout.split()[2]; add=lambda q,*o: (lambda p: (p.returncode,p.stdout+p.stderr))(r("gate","add",i,"--kind","provisional","--question",q,*[w for x in o for w in ("--option",x)],"--recommendation",o[0])); cases=[("May the probe spend 4 USD?","money"),("The capture needs sudo fs_usage; is it made?","operator-act"),("Keep the touches or drop the item?","scope"),("May a row name a program this machine will run on a downloaded file?","execute")]; out=[(q,k)+add(q,"yes","no") for q,k in cases]; bad=[(q,c,x[-160:]) for q,k,c,x in out if c!=0 or "(blocking)" not in x or "strict "+k not in x]; sys.exit("not blocking on a strict signal: %r" % bad if bad else 0)

import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t; d=t.mkdtemp(); r=lambda *a: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); i=r("new","story","--title","S","--goal","g","--touch","src/a.py").stdout.split()[2]; add=lambda q,*o: (lambda p: p.stdout+p.stderr)(r("gate","add",i,"--kind","provisional","--question",q,*[w for x in o for w in ("--option",x)],"--recommendation",o[0])); add("May the probe spend 4 USD?","yes","no"); p=r("answer",i,"g1","--provisional"); c=add("Which caps does the languages table hold?","1000 and 2000","caps in code only"); sys.exit("an agent answered a strict gate: "+p.stdout if p.returncode==0 else "the design control is not provisional: "+c if "(provisional)" not in c or "strict" in c else 0)

notes: Words, settled at planning 2026-10-28: money = USD, US dollars, dollars, paid, spend, billing, Actions minutes, a $ figure; operator act = sudo, only the operator, the operator creates, runs, makes, gives, adds or sets; scope = touches, drop the item, skip experiment, worth building, defer; execution = program and run within one clause, execute and its endings. bl_authority.strict_signals(gate) returns each kind with its word; set --touch re-derivation keeps such a gate blocking; check reports one that is provisional or agent-answered on an open item as an error; the gate's class is unchanged, so kbdecide, bl_plan and horizon read it as before; kb/_self/backlog.md (Gate classes) and kb/_self/tools.md describe it. Evidence: the gate-triage measurement of 2026-10-28 (ST-moy5v7tm g1 and ST-izw3nds4 g2 were class design and reached the operator only because the planner made them blocking). Check 2 passes before the work: it pins the critical test the work extends.
